tests.name: Captain Z destruction and podding persist

data.sql: SELECT 1 FROM players p JOIN ships lost ON lost.ship_id=1012 JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id WHERE p.player_id=@{attacker_player_player_id} AND lost.destroyed=TRUE AND lost.hull=0 AND st.name='Escape Pod' AND pod.destroyed=FALSE AND pod.sector_id=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ship_ownership o WHERE o.ship_id=pod.ship_id AND o.player_id=p.player_id AND o.is_primary=TRUE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM podded_status ps WHERE ps.player_id=p.player_id AND ps.status='podded');

tests.name: Insured ship destruction credits bank once

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{attacker_player_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=@{attacker_bank_before}+1000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_claims c JOIN insurance_policies p ON p.insurance_policies_id=c.policy_id WHERE p.subject_id=1012 AND c.status='paid' AND c.event_id='ship-destruction-1012')=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE idempotency_key='insurance-auto-1012-'||(SELECT insurance_policies_id::text FROM insurance_policies WHERE subject_id=1012 ORDER BY insurance_policies_id DESC LIMIT 1))=1;
